title: Verify default home view on emulator/device
description: Build + run app on an emulator, grant coarse location, confirm the default glance renders real NWS weather end-to-end. Add a Maestro 00-smoke flow. The data layer is unit-tested but the wired app has not been run yet.
close_reason: Verified on Pixel_7_API_34: cold launch fetches live NWS data and renders the glance (79°, Mostly Clear, NEW YORK, NY). Maestro 00-smoke.yaml added and passing.

title: Default minimalist home view
description: The calm, zero-setup default: large current temperature + one-line plain-language conditions answer + location. Glanceable in <1s. ViewModel fetches via weather repository; loading/error/empty states; whitespace-forward layout. The single most important glance.
notes: Default glance implemented (location, big temp, conditions line, refresh, loading/error states) + sealed HomeUiState + HomeViewModel. NOT yet verified on a device/emulator — only builds + unit tests. See verification follow-up.
close_reason: Default minimalist home view delivered and verified on Pixel_7_API_34. Maestro smoke green.

title: Weather data layer (NWS port)
description: Port almanac-bell's NWS client to Kotlin: HTTP client (OkHttp) with User-Agent, retry on 429/503 w/ Retry-After, 10s timeout; unit conversions (C->F, mm->in, ->mph, Pa->inHg, wind-string parse); wire DTOs (kotlinx.serialization) for /points, /stations, observations, alerts, hourly forecast; domain models (PointsLookup, CurrentObservation, ForecastPoint); repository with caching; location resolution. Reference: /Users/evanray/Projects/raylytics/almanac-bell/mobile/src/nws/.
notes: Core NWS port DONE & unit-tested (Units 7 tests, NwsClient 4 tests via fake transport): client, retry, conversions, wire/domain split, WeatherRepository, LocationProvider. Remaining: forecast endpoint is ported but unused/untested; point-resolution cache is in-memory only (not persisted).
close_reason: Core NWS port complete and verified live end-to-end via the emulator smoke test (resolveLocation -> getObservation against api.weather.gov). 11 unit tests green. Deferred polish (persisted cache, forecast endpoint tests) split into a separate task.

title: Project foundation & scaffolding
description: Gradle/Compose/Material3 scaffold for the Just My Weather Android app following Raylytics Kotlin conventions (single app module, Gradle 8.13, AGP 8.7.3, Kotlin 2.1.20, ktlint, compileSdk 36/minSdk 24, JVM 17, package io.raylytics.justmyweather). Includes wrapper, build files, manifest, theme, app entry, CLAUDE.md, README.
close_reason: Scaffold complete: Gradle 8.13/AGP 8.7.3/Kotlin 2.1.20, Compose+Material3 single module, manual DI, ktlint+.editorconfig, pre-commit hook, CLAUDE.md+README. Debug APK assembles, 11 unit tests green.

title: Alerts screen + rule builder
description: Alerts screen: list rules (When <field> is <above/below> <threshold>), enable/disable, delete; simple add-rule form (field, above/below, threshold). Calm empty state. Reached from home. Request POST_NOTIFICATIONS on entry.

title: WorkManager polling + local notifications
description: Periodic AlertWorker: load enabled rules + weather, evaluate, notify only on transition into fired (dedup via persisted firing set) so nothing nags. Personal-alerts notification channel; POST_NOTIFICATIONS handling. Quiet by default (no rules -> worker no-ops).

title: Alert rules persistence (DataStore)
description: AlertRulesRepository over DataStore (JSON list) + firing-state set for transition dedup. Pure codec tested on JVM.

title: Alert rule model + pure evaluator
description: AlertRule (numeric WeatherField + above/below + threshold + enabled), reusing the field catalog. Pure AlertEvaluator: (rule, snapshot) -> FireDecision with a plain-language reason. Numeric fields only (temp/wind/precip/pressure). Ported in spirit from almanac-bell's evaluator. Tested.

title: View customization: visual density spectrum
description: Let the user set where they live on the density spectrum — from a single large number to a fuller dashboard (hero size, row spacing/compactness, show/hide secondary chrome like the Updated line). Persisted with ViewConfig.

title: View customization: theming (type, color, light/dark)
description: Let the user adjust look & feel: typography (family/weight), accent color, and light/dark/system mood. Theme choices persisted via DataStore alongside ViewConfig. Palette + type already centralized in ui/theme for this.

title: Render home view from ViewConfig + customize screen
description: HomeViewModel combines weather snapshot + ViewConfig into display items (hero + secondary rows in user order). Customize screen: toggle visibility, reorder (up/down), relabel; saves to DataStore. Simple state-based navigation between home and customize (no nav lib).
close_reason: Delivered: WeatherField catalog, ViewConfig model + pure edits, ViewConfigCodec + DataStore repo, config-driven home render + customize screen with live updates. 28 tests; verified on emulator.

title: DataStore-backed ViewConfig persistence
description: Persist ViewConfig via Preferences DataStore (one JSON key). Pure ViewConfigCodec (encode/decode, forward-compatible: drop unknown field keys, append newly-added fields as hidden) tested on JVM; thin repository exposes Flow<ViewConfig>.
close_reason: Delivered: WeatherField catalog, ViewConfig model + pure edits, ViewConfigCodec + DataStore repo, config-driven home render + customize screen with live updates. 28 tests; verified on emulator.

title: Weather field catalog + ViewConfig model
description: A WeatherField catalog (temperature/conditions/wind/precip/pressure) where each field knows its key, default label, and how to format its value from a WeatherSnapshot — the obvious extension point for 'add a data point'. ViewConfig = ordered list of field settings (visible, custom label); first visible field is the hero. Default reproduces the current calm glance. Pure + tested.
close_reason: Delivered: WeatherField catalog, ViewConfig model + pure edits, ViewConfigCodec + DataStore repo, config-driven home render + customize screen with live updates. 28 tests; verified on emulator.

title: Data layer: persist point cache + cover forecast endpoint
description: Two deferred bits from the NWS port: (1) WeatherRepository's point-resolution cache is in-memory only — persist it (DataStore/Room) so resolution survives process death; (2) getHourlyForecast is ported but unused and lacks unit tests — add coverage when the alerting/forecast features need it.

title: Testing & tooling
description: JUnit5 + Mockito-Kotlin unit tests (units, evaluator, viewmodels), ktlint, pre-commit hook (scripts/hooks/pre-commit running :app:test :app:ktlintCheck), Maestro smoke flow (.maestro/00-smoke.yaml), CI.

title: Persistence & settings
description: DataStore-backed persistence for view config, theme, saved location(s), and alert rules. Settings screen. Versioned migration pattern.
notes: DataStore foundation delivered + view config persisted (ViewConfigRepository). Remaining: persist saved location(s) and alert rules; a Settings screen.

title: Personal alerting
description: First-class personal, rule-based alerts (distinct from almanac-bell hazard alerts). Port pure-function evaluator (temperature/precip/wind/overnight-low/frost thresholds); rule model + DataStore/Room persistence; simple rule-builder UI; WorkManager periodic polling w/ coalescing; local notifications w/ user-controlled tone/frequency; quiet by default.

title: View customization layer
description: User-owned view: pick which data points appear, reorder/prioritize, control visual density (single number -> fuller dashboard), theming (typography, color, light/dark mood), rename/relabel. Customization persisted via DataStore. Editing-down model, not theming a fixed layout.
notes: Content customization DONE (pick/order/relabel, persisted, live). Remaining for this epic: theming (typography/color/light-dark mood) and the visual-density spectrum (single-number <-> fuller dashboard). See follow-ups.

title: Maestro flow for customize screen (needs testTags)
description: Add testTags to the customize controls (switches/reorder) and a Maestro flow (01-customize.yaml) that toggles a field and asserts it appears on home, to lock in the behavior verified manually this session.

title: Launcher icon fallback for API 24-25
description: Only an adaptive icon (mipmap-anydpi-v26) ships; pre-26 devices have no bitmap fallback. Add density PNG/webp fallbacks or a legacy mipmap so the launcher icon renders on minSdk 24-25.

title: Open-source readiness
description: Legible codebase for contributors: README, CONTRIBUTING, docs on adding a data point / alert rule type / theme, LICENSE, self-explaining structure. Documentation as part of the product.
